units.source_text: 有时我觉得金阁宛如我掌心攥着的小巧玲珑的手工艺品，有时我又觉得它是高耸云端的庞然大物般的庙宇。

en.t: At times I felt that the Golden Pavilion was like a tiny, exquisite handicraft clasped in the palm of my hand; at other times I felt it was a vast temple towering up into the clouds.

units.source_text: 少年时代的我并没有认为所谓美就是不大不小的适当的东西。

en.t: In my boyhood, I did not think that what people called beauty was something of moderate, neither large nor small, proportions.

units.source_text: 因此，看到夏天的小花像是被晨露濡湿散发出朦胧的光的时候，我就觉得它像金阁一般的美。

en.t: Therefore, when I saw a small summer flower seeming to glow dimly after being moistened by the morning dew, I felt it was beautiful like the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 还有，看到山那边云层翻卷、雷声阵阵、惟有暗淡的云烟边缘金光灿灿的景象的时候，

en.t: And when I saw clouds rolling beyond the mountain, thunder rumbling, and only the edges of the dark mist and clouds shining with gold,

units.source_text: 这种壮观就使我联想起金阁来。

en.t: that magnificent sight made me think of the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 最后甚至看到美人的脸蛋，我心中也会用"像金阁一般的美"来形容了。

en.t: In the end, even when I saw the face of a beautiful woman, I would describe it in my heart as "beautiful like the Golden Pavilion."
